skill.description: Helps teams write clear product changelogs, release notes, feature announcements, visuals, and distribution plans.

security_audit.summary: Most Ruby backtick findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, not executable Ruby or shell interpolation. The install command on SKILL.md line 14 is confirmed critical because it pipes a remote script directly to sh. The skill also grants broad infsh command access, so users may send product data to external services.

remediation.issue: Remote install script executed through a shell pipeline.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-sh installation with signed downloads, checksum verification, and explicit user-run commands.

remediation.issue: Broad Bash(infsh *) permission can run any infsh subcommand.
remediation.suggestion: Narrow allowed commands to required infsh app run calls and require confirmation before external uploads.

remediation.issue: Visual-generation examples may send product URLs or screenshots to external services.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to submit confidential URLs, images, or unreleased product details.

content.value_statement: Release notes often become developer logs that users skip. This skill helps turn product changes into clear changelogs, announcements, visuals, and distribution plans.
actual_capabilities: Rewrite engineering changes into user-facing release notes.
Categorize updates as New, Improved, Fixed, Removed, or Security.
Choose semantic or date-based version labels.
Structure changelog pages and dated release sections.
Plan visuals for UI updates and feature launches.
Adapt announcements for email, in-app, blog, social, and community channels.
limitations: Does not collect product changes automatically.
Does not verify release accuracy against source code.
Requires product context, user impact, and launch timing.
Uses external inference.sh examples when generating visuals.

use_cases.title: Prepare Weekly Release Notes
use_cases.description: Turn shipped work into dated changelog entries with clear categories and user benefits.

use_cases.title: Announce Feature Launches
use_cases.description: Create concise release copy for in-app messages, email updates, and launch posts.

use_cases.title: Document API Changes
use_cases.description: Write breaking-change notices with migration steps, timelines, and support links.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Simple Changelog Entry
prompt_templates.prompt: Write one user-facing changelog entry for this change: [describe the change]. Include category, title, benefit, and one sentence.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite Developer Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn internal notes into customer language.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite these developer notes as release notes for customers: [paste notes]. Group them as New, Improved, Fixed, Removed, or Security.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Launch Announcement
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a launch announcement plan for [feature]. Include changelog copy, in-app copy, email copy, social copy, and suggested visuals.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Breaking Change Notice
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a breaking-change release note for [change]. Include impact, affected users, migration steps, timeline, and support guidance.

output_examples.output: New: Bulk Export for Reports. You can now export up to 10,000 rows from any report view.

output_examples.input: Developer note: Fixed timezone bug in date picker and optimized dashboard queries.
output: Improved: Dashboards now load faster when filtering large datasets.
Fixed: Date pickers now show the correct timezone for every workspace.

output_examples.input: API v1 will stop working on March 15, 2026.
output_examples.output: Breaking: API v1 ends on March 15, 2026. Move integrations to API v2 before that date.

best_practices: Lead with what users can do now.
Group changes by category and date.
Add screenshots or short demos for visible product changes.
anti_patterns: Do not publish commit logs as changelogs.
Do not use vague phrases like bug fixes and improvements.
Do not bury breaking changes below routine updates.

faq.question: Can this skill write release notes from engineering notes?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the shipped changes, user impact, and release date for better results.

faq.question: Does it choose version numbers?
faq.answer: It explains semantic and date-based versioning, then suggests a label from your release context.

faq.question: Can it create visual changelog ideas?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests screenshots, before-after views, callouts, charts, banners, or short demos.

faq.question: Does it publish changelogs automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps draft and structure content, but publishing stays under user control.

faq.question: Is it useful for API releases?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for versioned APIs, deprecation notices, migration steps, and timelines.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
